build_system: dotnet CLI / MSBuild. WorshipPlayer.Core (net8.0) builds on Linux. WorshipPlayer.Presenter/UI/Audio are net8.0-windows and require EnableWindowsTargeting for cross-platform build. Tests use linked Compile includes from Presenter services.
test_framework: xunit 2.6.6 with Microsoft.NET.Test.Sdk 17.8.0. Tests in WorshipPlayer.Tests/ reference Core directly and link Presenter service .cs files via <Compile Include>. Pattern: one test class per service/feature.
build_command: dotnet build WorshipPlayer.Core --nologo && dotnet build WorshipPlayer.Tests --nologo
verification_instructions: 1. Run 'dotnet build WorshipPlayer.Core' to verify Core models/services compile. 2. Run 'dotnet test WorshipPlayer.Tests' to verify all tests pass. 3. For Presenter project on Linux, add EnableWindowsTargeting to .csproj or verify by building Core+Tests only.
setup_instructions: dotnet restore on root .sln. Core and Tests build on Linux. Presenter/UI/Audio require Windows or EnableWindowsTargeting property.
environment_constraints: Linux sandbox - cannot run WPF apps. Can build Core (net8.0) and run tests. Presenter project targets net8.0-windows with UseWPF. Tests link Presenter service code directly via <Compile Include> for testability. NuGet restore available (internet mode).
contribution_requirements: VIFCRE on every commit. OWC Design Identity colors. All windows resizable. Dark theme ComboBox styling. ScrollViewer+MaxHeight on dynamic lists. Empty states. organizationId on data models. Sanitize file paths. Works offline (local JSON/SQLite). Use interfaces for external services. Port 5055. Segoe UI font. Cursor=Hand on buttons.
key_patterns: Models use System.Text.Json with [JsonPropertyName]. Services use async file I/O. Events use EventHandler<T>. Tests link .cs files from Presenter via <Compile Include>. ThemeManager pattern: load from folder, save as JSON, built-in defaults. ServiceOrderManager pattern: CRUD with events. ChordProParserService: stateless parser service. SlideTheme: comprehensive styling model. VideoLibrary: folder scanning model.
directory_structure: Root: .sln + song audio files + ServiceOrders/ + Songs/ folders. WorshipPlayer.Core/Models/ - shared data models. WorshipPlayer.Core/Services/ - shared business logic. WorshipPlayer.Presenter/Views/ - WPF windows/XAML. WorshipPlayer.Presenter/Services/ - presenter-specific services. WorshipPlayer.Presenter/Models/ - presenter-specific models. WorshipPlayer.Presenter/Themes/ - XAML resource dictionaries. WorshipPlayer.Tests/ - xunit tests with linked Presenter sources.
